title: ASTM Committee F24 formed
description: ASTM International creates Committee F24 on Amusement Rides and Devices, the home of F2291, F770, F1193 and F2974.

title: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad derailment at Disneyland
description: A guide wheel comes off a train and the locomotive is forced onto the first car; one guest dies. Maintenance omissions are later acknowledged.

title: ISO 17842-1 first edition published
description: ISO/TC 254 publishes the first international ride design standard, later withdrawn in favour of the 2023 edition.

title: The Smiler collision at Alton Towers
description: A loaded train is released into a stalled empty train after engineers override the block system; several riders are seriously injured.

title: Thunder River Rapids tragedy at Dreamworld
description: A pump failure strands a raft on the conveyor and the following raft collides with it; four people die.

title: Fire Ball failure at the Ohio State Fair
description: A gondola arm separates in motion; one rider dies. The manufacturer attributes it to hidden internal corrosion and halts similar rides worldwide.

title: Queensland coroner delivers Dreamworld findings
description: Coroner James McDougall finds no engineering risk assessment was ever done and calls the park's safety systems frighteningly unsophisticated.

title: ISO 17842-1:2023 second edition published
description: The revised international design standard replaces the 2015 edition.
